'''Healing crystals''' were objects that aided in [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]]. They were sometimes given as gifts in the [[Padawan birthday ritual]], and in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vokara Che]] used a healing crystal to treat fellow Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] injuries sustained in a terrorist attack.
